rationale.rules-based-checks: Implements deterministic linters, AST checks, regexes, and unit tests for AI code.
rationale.quality-debt: Measures functional regressions and non-security quality failures across generated code.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes functional-correctness-only evaluation as misaligned with human preference.
rationale.built-system: Authors implement thirty verifiers and the runnable SWE-IF testbed.
rationale.agentic: Evaluates complete implementations under single-turn and multi-turn artifact-level generation.
rationale.steering: Injects non-functional constraints into prompts as a substantive evaluation design.
rationale.metrics: Defines quality scores for instruction compliance, functionality, regression, and preference alignment.
rationale.risk-quality: Empirically analyzes functionality, style, logic, documentation, and maintainability-related quality.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled tasks compare thirty-one third-party models across instruction conditions.
rationale.method-mining: Correlates benchmark scores with mined LMArena coding preference ratings.
